get.summary: Show a single target hours rule by ID (full field set).
get.data: The target hours rule object (full API payload).

list.summary: List target hours rules of all users, of the authenticated user (me) or of one user.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: me = authenticated user, a number = that user. Default: all users the API key may see.

list.requests: GET /targethours (cached with CACHE=1); me adds GET /v4/users/me
notes: me is rejected with --curl; pass a numeric user ID.
list.data: Array of target hours rule objects (full API payload).
